'''Xizor's mother''' was a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], the wife of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Haxim]] and the queen of [[Haxim's province|his provincial kingdom]]. She perished in [[7 BBY/Legends|7 BBY]] during an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] of Falleen executed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. She was survived by her son, [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], but her [[Xizor's sister|two]] [[Xizor's second sister|daughters]] and husband perished.
